description: This file defines a shell script for configuring and managing a QMI (Qualcomm MSM Interface) based cellular connection in a network interface provisioning context. It includes functions to initialize configuration, setup network interfaces, and teardown connections using uqmi commands and interacts with system and network state via ubus and JSON utilities.

methods.name: proto_qmi_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the QMI protocol configuration parameters with default values and user-provided settings.

methods.name: proto_qmi_setup
methods.description: Sets up the QMI interface by configuring the device, verifying SIM status, registering to the network, and establishing data connections for IPv4 and IPv6.

methods.name: qmi_wds_stop
methods.description: Stops a WDS (Wireless Data Service) network connection and releases associated client IDs.

methods.name: proto_qmi_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the QMI network interface, stopping active connections and cleaning up states.
